Class Floor

java.lang.Object
fr.uge.map.Floor
public class Floor extends Object
Represents a floor in the dungeon with a grid of rooms.

      public void add(Room room, int line, int column)
      Adds a room at the specified position.
      Parameters:
      room - the Room to add
      line - the row index (0-4)
      column - the column index (0-10)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if a room is already at that position

    • hasRoom

      public boolean hasRoom(int x, int y)
      Checks if there is a room at the given coordinates.
      Parameters:
      x - the row index (0-4)
      y - the column index (0-10)
      Returns:
      true if a room exists at (x, y), false otherwise

    • getRoom

      public Room getRoom(int x, int y)
      Returns the room at the given coordinates.
      Parameters:
      x - the row index (0-4)
      y - the column index (0-10)
      Returns:
      the Room at (x, y), or null if no room exists

    • placeHero

      public void placeHero(int x, int y)
      Places the hero at the specified coordinates on the floor.
      Parameters:
      x - the row index (0-4)
      y - the column index (0-10)

    • initPlaceHero

      public void initPlaceHero()
      Places the hero in the first corridor room found on the floor.

    • getPlaceHero

      public int[] getPlaceHero()
      Returns the current coordinates of the hero on this floor.
      Returns:
      an array with [heroX, heroY]

    • goodPath

      public boolean goodPath(Room current, Room target, List<Room> visited)
      Checks if there is a valid path from the current room to the target room. Only corridor rooms or the target room itself can be used in the path.
      Parameters:
      current - the starting room
      target - the destination room
      visited - the list of already visited rooms
      Returns:
      true if a path exists, false otherwise

    • isAccessible

      public boolean isAccessible(int x, int y)
      Checks if the room at (x, y) is accessible from the hero's current position.
      Parameters:
      x - the row index (0-4)
      y - the column index (0-10)
      Returns:
      true if the room exists, is not the hero's current room, and is reachable via corridors

    • heroX

      public int heroX()
      Returns the hero's current row index on the floor.

    • heroY

      public int heroY()
      Returns the hero's current column index on the floor.

    • generateRandomRoom

      public Room generateRandomRoom(Room gridRoom)
      Generates a random room based on the type probabilities. If the room was already generated, returns the existing generated room.
      Parameters:
      gridRoom - the base room to generate from
      Returns:
      the generated Room

    • tryUnlockGrid

      public boolean tryUnlockGrid(Room grid, Hero hero)
      Tries to unlock a room/grid using a key from the hero's backpack.
      Parameters:
      grid - the room to unlock
      hero - the hero attempting to unlock the room
      Returns:
      true if the room was unlocked or already visited, false if no key is available

    • addAllNeighbor

      public void addAllNeighbor()
      Adds all adjacent rooms as neighbors for each room in the floor grid. Checks up, down, left, and right for existing rooms.

    • createFloors

      public static List<Floor> createFloors()
      Creates 3 floors with rooms and corridors. Adds neighbors for all rooms.
      Returns:
      list of the 3 floors
